headline: SHOUT ORDERS AT THE DUNGEON — GAUNTLET'S PARTNER NOW SPEAKS BACK WITH ITS FEET
lede: Press V, allow the mic, then say "take the upper right", "grab the key", "follow me" or "hold here" — the CPU partner obeys, the screen shows what it heard, and the recording logs every call. Ten mazes, four heroes, one very vocal co-op seat.

notes.text: #1249 shipped: speech recognition (browser-local) -> intent -> the seat's own goal-setting BFS. The partner still emits nothing but pad events, so a trained model can drop into the same seat later — the words are the only new thing.

The seat keeps its manners while obeying: food when badly hurt outranks any order, it keeps cutting what walks into its blade, waits at locked doors, and refuses honestly (NO KEY / NO WAY) instead of wandering.

voicecmdcheck: 59 Node gates including the proven full quest WON with twenty spoken calls shouted along the way; a mutant deaf-seat run dies ten ways. The headless drive caught two real bugs before merge — recorder stamp clocks and seat-2 pad capture.
Heard on screen: the words you said, the order the seat took, green or red, plus a MIC ON pill naming the live command — a misheard corner never reads as an order lost.
